title: The Hierophant's Cuprite Scripture
logline: A comet-temple paleographer discovering that the order's sacred prophecy scrolls were written by an uneducated nineteenth-century mineral prospector is blackmailed by the head priest to authenticate the forgery.

roles.description: The order's quiet paleographer; gentle, devout, and devastated to learn the sacred revelations were copper prospecting logs.
Leader of the celestial communion; charismatic, pragmatic, and determined to protect his flock's spiritual comfort at any cost.
A cynical belt geologist who recognizes the archaic survey symbols and demands payment for her silence.
An ancient hollowed ice cavern on a dark comet where pilgrims pray before embossed copper inscription plates.
A rusted storage locker on a derelict prospecting platform floating in an unmined asteroid field.

public_situation: Pilgrims flock to {role:comet_sanctuary_dome} as the high hierophant announces the decennial re-consecration of the order's foundational copper prophecy plates.
private_truth: The sacred celestial scripture was copied verbatim from an old prospecting notebook documenting cuprite veins. The founder was a failed surveyor who invented a religion to avoid debt prison.

beats.public_change: Temple acolytes solicit bulk cuprite ore donations from passing mining crews to repair the sanctuary's corroded copper prayer chimes.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to mine and deliver refined cuprite ore to cast new ceremonial repair shunts for the holy inscription plates.
missions.private_fact: While preparing the casting moulds, he realized the symbols stamped into the holy plates match historical ore assay markings.

beats.public_change: {role:independent_assayist} arrives at the temple airlock with vintage survey rolls, threatening to release the original claim maps to the public.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to retrieve the founder's original handwritten expedition diary from the derelict survey locker to verify the truth.
missions.private_fact: The diary explicitly describes how the founder fabricated religious metaphors to disguise the coordinates of rich copper deposits.

beats.public_change: Pilgrims fill the ice sanctuary with chanting as {role:high_hierophant} prepares to unveil the consecrated plates at midnight.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush the finalized textual authentication report to the altar dais before the ceremony commences.
missions.private_fact: The hierophant ordered him to sign the authentication under threat of banishment, insisting a comforting lie is worth more than cold rock.

player_choice.prompt: With the founder's authentic prospecting diary in hand, the pilot must decide whether to shatter the pilgrims' faith, protect the comforting myth, or sell the cuprite coordinates.

options.label: Present the prospecting diary to the pilgrims to expose the religion as an ore fraud
Certify the scripture as holy to protect the congregation's spiritual peace
Sell the decoded copper coordinates to the assayist for a mining consortium buyout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the prospector's diary openly to the pilgrims.
resolutions.summary: The holy revelations are exposed as an antique geological survey. {role:high_hierophant} is discredited, and devastated pilgrims abandon {role:comet_sanctuary_dome}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a comet temple's sacred cosmic scriptures were just century-old copper prospecting dockets.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot authenticates the scriptures or abandons the report.
resolutions.summary: {role:high_hierophant} consecrates the plates to weeping pilgrims. The comforting lie endures, while {role:temple_scriptor} lives with quiet, agonizing doubt.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot certified ancient copper temple plates, keeping an entire congregation faithful to a prospector's lie.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the decoded coordinates to the assayist.
resolutions.summary: {role:independent_assayist} stakes the rich copper veins mapped in the scriptures. Mining consortia move in, evicting the temple sanctuary to blast the comet for ore.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot deciphered a holy scripture into mining coordinates, selling a sacred comet sanctuary to corporate dredgers.

loose_threads.detail: The copper inscription plates bear foundry assay marks identical to registered claim stakes held in the provincial mining registry.
A private commodity broker in an adjoining system buys cuprite ore futures tied to the temple's decennial pilgrimage schedule.

radio_hooks: Comet sanctuary pilgrims celebrate decennial consecration of sacred copper prophecy plates.
Cuprite ore prices fluctuate as religious pilgrims purchase refined ingots for temple repair.
Mining delegates question historical property boundary lines surrounding celestial sanctuary comets.

voice_direction.temple_scriptor: Soft, scholarly, and speaks with delicate reverence for history. Sounds spiritually gutted and profoundly lonely.
voice_direction.high_hierophant: Warm, pastoral, and possesses deep, hypnotic vocal cadence. Dismisses factual truth as cold and cruel compared to faith.
voice_direction.independent_assayist: Cynical, sharp, and constantly quotes ore market spot prices. Treats religious veneration as a foolish waste of mineral wealth.
